Norman Graves has started travelling again and, this time is at Banff, in Scotland. For the uninitiated Banff is 587 miles from London on the N.E.
Norman Graves is now over the water to do his first bit of Continental running. Before he left, he won the Herts County Three Miles Race in 16 mins. 25 secs.

Norman Graves made a plucky effort in the Two Miles, but was unable to hold Stent of Finchley over the last lap.
